 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill the single-cell gaps between horizontally aligned markers."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [v for v, n in counts.items() if v != background]
    if not markers:
        return out
    marker = markers[0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(len(row) - 2):
            if row[c] == marker and row[c + 2] == marker and row[c + 1] == background:
                out[r][c + 1] = 2
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[1,3,1,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3],
            [3,3,3,1,3,1,3,1,3,1,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3,3],

    assert got[0][:3] == [1,2,1]
